culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Check in at the Zuni Visitor Center before entering the Pueblo; guided tours are required and visitors stay with the guide on set routes. Don't drive through residential areas or climb structures; no alcohol, weapons, drugs or pets.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Photography needs a permit from the Visitor Center, and ask before photographing people. Photographing, video or audio recording and sketching of religious or cultural ceremonies are prohibited; no permits are issued on ceremonial days. Kivas and graveyards are off limits.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Pueblo of Zuni (Zuni Tourism / Zuni Visitor Center).
